units.source: Block references

Block references are __TRILIUM_PH_0__links__TRILIUM_PH_1__ to a block of a text note, such as a paragraph, a heading, a list item or a table, or to a range of consecutive blocks. A block reference can be pasted in another note as a link, or turned into an __TRILIUM_PH_2__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_3__ that shows only the referenced blocks.
Copying a reference__TRILIUM_PH_0__
Place the cursor in the block to reference. To reference several consecutive blocks, select them.

Right-click the block handle, the sequence of dots to the left of the block (see __TRILIUM_PH_0__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_1__), and select __TRILIUM_PH_2__Copy reference__TRILIUM_PH_3__. With the fixed formatting toolbar, clicking the block handle opens the same menu. Alternatively, right-click the text and select __TRILIUM_PH_4__Copy reference to this block__TRILIUM_PH_5__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_6__Copy__TRILIUM_PH_7__ submenu, or __TRILIUM_PH_8__Copy reference to these blocks__TRILIUM_PH_9__ for a selection. The referenced blocks flash briefly.
Go to the note where to insert the link and press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__V__TRILIUM_PH_3__.

Inside a __TRILIUM_PH_0__Content tabs__TRILIUM_PH_1__ block, the reference points to the whole block. To link to a single tab, use __TRILIUM_PH_2__Copy reference to this tab__TRILIUM_PH_3__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_4__ __TRILIUM_PH_5__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_6__ menu of the tabs block instead. Inside a __TRILIUM_PH_7__Multicolumn layout__TRILIUM_PH_8__, the reference points to the blocks in the column, and an include shows them without the layout around them.

The link shows the title of the note, followed by the beginning of the referenced text. A link to blocks of the same note shows only the beginning of the referenced text, and a link to a heading of the same note shows the whole heading.

If the note is __TRILIUM_PH_0__shared__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the menu of the block handle also offers __TRILIUM_PH_2__Copy public link__TRILIUM_PH_3__. It copies the web address of the shared page with the reference added, to send to people who read the note outside Trilium. Opening the address scrolls the shared page to the referenced blocks and flashes them. On a shared page, a link to blocks of another shared note does the same.
The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Paste__TRILIUM_PH_1__ submenu of the context menu offers two more ways to insert a copied reference:
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Paste reference as a link__TRILIUM_PH_1__ inserts only the link, even when the reference was copied as plain text or along with other content.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Paste reference as an excerpt__TRILIUM_PH_1__ inserts an include of the referenced blocks, as described below.
In a browser, the context menu of the text editor opens only when right-clicking selected text. Elsewhere the browser shows its own menu.
Linking to a heading__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Block references > Linking to a heading

units.source: Since v0.107.0, a link to a heading of the same note can be created from the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Add link__TRILIUM_PH_1__ dialog:
units.context: Block references > Linking to a heading

units.source: Place the cursor at the desired position of the link, or select the text to turn into a link.
units.context: Block references > Linking to a heading

units.source: Press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__K__TRILIUM_PH_3__ or the __TRILIUM_PH_4__ button in the __TRILIUM_PH_5__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_6__, then select __TRILIUM_PH_7__Heading / anchor__TRILIUM_PH_8__ at the top of the dialog. Alternatively, choose __TRILIUM_PH_9__Link to a heading or anchor__TRILIUM_PH_10__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_11__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_12__, which opens the dialog on that page.
units.context: Block references > Linking to a heading

units.source: Under __TRILIUM_PH_0__Headings__TRILIUM_PH_1__, click the desired heading to check it. Sub-headings are listed under their heading and start collapsed; expand or collapse a heading with the arrow in front of it, or with __TRILIUM_PH_2__→__TRILIUM_PH_3__ and __TRILIUM_PH_4__←__TRILIUM_PH_5__ while it is focused. Optionally, type a __TRILIUM_PH_6__Link title__TRILIUM_PH_7__.
units.context: Block references > Linking to a heading

units.source: Press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Insert link__TRILIUM_PH_3__ to confirm.
units.context: Block references > Linking to a heading

units.source: When the link title is not set, the link displays the text of the heading. If the heading gets changed, the link is renamed automatically to the new text, shortly after you stop typing. A link with a title of its own keeps that title.
units.context: Block references > Linking to a heading

units.source: The link is a block reference to the heading, so it keeps working when the heading is moved. To change the link, click it and press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button in its popup. For a link with a title of its own, placing the cursor inside it and pressing __TRILIUM_PH_3__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_4__+__TRILIUM_PH_5__K__TRILIUM_PH_6__ works too. The dialog opens on __TRILIUM_PH_7__Heading / anchor__TRILIUM_PH_8__, with the heading checked. Emptying the __TRILIUM_PH_9__Link title__TRILIUM_PH_10__ there makes the link display the text of the heading again.
units.context: Block references > Linking to a heading

units.source: Following a reference__TRILIUM_PH_0__

Clicking a block reference opens the note, scrolls to the referenced blocks and flashes them. If a referenced block was deleted, an error message is shown instead, along with the blocks of the range that still exist.

A link to blocks of the note it is in, such as a link to a heading, scrolls to them and flashes them without leaving the note, as a link within a web page does. This works in read-only notes and on shared pages too. While editing, clicking the link shows its popup: press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Jump to heading__TRILIUM_PH_1__ there, or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Jump to block__TRILIUM_PH_3__ for other blocks.
Including the referenced blocks__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Block references > Including the referenced blocks

units.source: To show the referenced blocks inside another note, right-click the link in a note being edited and select __TRILIUM_PH_0__Convert link to note excerpt__TRILIUM_PH_1__, or paste the copied reference with __TRILIUM_PH_2__Paste__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Paste reference as an excerpt__TRILIUM_PH_5__. The include shows only the referenced blocks, not the rest of the note, and marks them with an __TRILIUM_PH_6__Excerpt__TRILIUM_PH_7__ badge in its title. It starts at the __TRILIUM_PH_8__Full__TRILIUM_PH_9__ box size, so all the referenced blocks are visible. To see the whole note, press the __TRILIUM_PH_10__ button in the same title, which opens the note in a new tab. Converting the include back to a link keeps the reference.
units.context: Block references > Including the referenced blocks

units.source: To edit the referenced blocks without leaving the note, press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Edit excerpt__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button in the title of the include, or turn on __TRILIUM_PH_3__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_4__ (__TRILIUM_PH_5__) in its toolbar, as for any __TRILIUM_PH_6__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_7__. Press the button again to stop editing. The changes are saved to the referenced blocks, and the rest of the note stays as it is. The button is grayed out where the blocks cannot be edited, such as in a read-only note. An excerpt has no __TRILIUM_PH_8__Fullscreen__TRILIUM_PH_9__ button.
units.context: Block references > Including the referenced blocks

units.source: If a referenced block was deleted, the include shows __TRILIUM_PH_0__Broken reference__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Block references > Including the referenced blocks

units.source: Limitations__TRILIUM_PH_0__
References can be copied only from a note being edited, and not in the mobile layout.
An include of a range that covers only part of a list or a quote, such as from its second item to a paragraph after it, cannot be edited in place.
Deleting a block breaks the references to it.
Block references are not kept when exporting to Markdown. On a __TRILIUM_PH_0__shared page__TRILIUM_PH_1__, a block reference opens the whole note.
